notes.title: Frog Stool Dev Log – Update 1.6
notes.content:
Hey fwanks!
We just dropped a juicy new update for Frogstool, squashing bats and making big leaps (literally). Here's what's new in this patch:

🎮 Gameplay Improvements

Fixed a pesky issue where jump inputs wouldn’t always register. Your frog’s got hops again—reliable and responsive!

Improved the attack system: attacks now last a bit longer and continue even after landing. Smooth, satisfying combat for maximum tongue-lashing.

🤝 Multiplayer Update

Co-op just got a whole lot better. We tackled every known multiplayer bug, creating a seamless couch experience. Ribbit together, fight together.

🏆 Steam Achievements

All Steam achievements are now fully functional! Your feats of froggery will finally be recognized and rewarded as they should. No more missed achievements for heroic deeds.

This one’s all about tightening up the experience and making Frogstool feel crisp, clean, and rad as hell. More content and surprises are on the way—stay tuned!

Until next hop,
🐸 – Stinker Studioz
